title: NEET UG 2026 (Re-Exam) — Official Question Paper (Code 50)
description: Official National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (UG) 2026 Re-Examination paper (Booklet Code 50). 180 compulsory questions across Physics (Q1-45), Chemistry (Q46-90), and Biology (Q91-180) with official answer keys.

instructions.en: The question paper comprises 180 compulsory multiple choice questions: Physics (Q1-45), Chemistry (Q46-90), and Biology (Q91-180). Each correct answer carries +4 marks and -1 for wrong answer. Total time: 180 minutes. Maximum marks: 720.
